page.title: DNS
page.description: Zones, records, name server delegation and propagation at your DNS provider.

empty.title: Connect a DNS provider
empty.body: Connect Cloudflare or Route53 under Domains, DNS provider, then manage zones and records here with the same credentials.
empty.noZonesBody: Create a zone for a domain you own, then point your registrar at its name servers.

wizard.title: Bring a domain onto DNS

lead.domain: Create a zone for a domain you own at any registrar.
lead.nameservers: Set exactly these name servers at your registrar, replacing the current ones.
lead.import: Copy the records the domain serves today, so nothing breaks when the name servers switch.
lead.verify: Public resolvers are asked which name servers the domain uses now.

wizard.domainHint: The registrable domain, for example example.com, not a subdomain.
wizard.registrarHint: At your registrar, open the domain's name server settings, choose custom name servers and paste these. Keep the old ones out: a mix answers inconsistently.
wizard.propagationHint: Registries usually publish the change within an hour; resolvers can hold the old answer for up to two days.

hint.delegated: Every resolver asked returns this zone's name servers.
hint.partially_delegated: Some resolvers still return other name servers. Wait for caches to expire, or remove stray servers at the registrar.
hint.delegated_elsewhere: The domain still points at other name servers. Update them at your registrar.
hint.not_delegated: No resolver returned name servers for this domain. Check the domain is registered and the name servers are set.

import.title: Import and export
import.lead: Bring records into {{zone}} from a zone file or JSON. Nothing changes until you apply the plan.
import.formatHint: BIND zone file or the JSON this page exports. SOA and apex NS are skipped.
import.replace: Replace: delete record sets missing from the import
import.exportLead: Download every record set except provider managed NS and SOA.
import.discoverHint: Common names were looked up at the domain's current name servers. Untick anything you do not want.
import.nothingFound: No records found at the current name servers.

plan.summary: {{create}} to create, {{update}} to update, {{delete}} to delete, {{unchanged}} unchanged
plan.blocked: Conflicts block this plan. Fix them and preview again.

records.emptyBody: Add a record, apply a template, or import a zone file.
records.noMatchBody: Try another name, value or type.
records.deleteLead_one: The record is removed at the provider right away.
records.deleteLead_other: All {{count}} values are removed at the provider right away.

record.lead: Changes are written to {{zone}} at the provider when you save.
record.name: Name
record.nameHint: Relative to {{zone}}: @ for the apex, * for a wildcard.

validation.name: The name is not a valid DNS name. A wildcard must be the leftmost label.
validation.ipv4: An A record needs an IPv4 address.
validation.ipv6: An AAAA record needs an IPv6 address.
validation.host: The target must be a host name.
validation.priority: Priority must be a number from 0 to 65535.
validation.weight: Weight must be a number from 0 to 65535.
validation.port: Port must be a number from 0 to 65535.
validation.caaTag: The CAA tag must be issue, issuewild or iodef.
validation.textTooLong: TXT text is limited to 4000 characters.
validation.cnameSingle: A CNAME holds exactly one target.
validation.apexNs: Apex NS records are managed by the provider.
validation.ttl: TTL must be between 30 and 604800 seconds.
validation.proxiedType: Only A, AAAA and CNAME records can be proxied.
validation.setIdentifier: Routed records need a set identifier.

templates.title: Apply a template
templates.lead: Common setups as record sets. Existing TXT values at the same name are kept, except a second SPF or DMARC record.

health.lead: Route53 health checks decide which failover or multivalue record answers.

zone.deleteLead: The zone and its name servers are removed at the provider. The domain stops resolving if it is still delegated here.
zone.deleteHasRecords_one: The zone still has {{count}} record set beyond NS and SOA. Export it first if you may need it.
zone.deleteHasRecords_other: The zone still has {{count}} record sets beyond NS and SOA. Export them first if you may need them.
zone.noChanges: No change made from here yet.
